thread:
maria: heads up — CI perf alert on the hosted suite after yesterday's merge (fused prefetch). decode p95 jumped ~2.5x on shortseq workloads, canary flagged :eyes:

devon: saw the CI failure, triage page shows warmup/kind of handoff thrash in the kv-prefetch path. stack trace points at fused_v2_prefetch() in runtime/decoder.cpp

ryan: can you paste the flamegraph snippet? wondering if it's kernel selection or just memcpy blowup

maria: here's the top of the profile from the failing CI run:
```
# top samples (shortseq)
30% fused_v2_prefetch
22% decode_step
12% attn_kernel_dispatch
9% kv_cache_evict::sync
7% cuda_memcpy_async
```

jess: that's... a lot in fused_v2_prefetch. we changed the handoff order to prefer fused prefetch kernels when seq_len < 32 — maybe the kernel chooser is misclassifying later in the pipeline

devon: repro on local tiny-run: same p95 spike after enabling fused-v2. disabling fused_v2_prefetch in runtime config brings p95 back to baseline

ci-bot: perf-ci: build/4421 FAILED — p95 decode +160% vs baseline (threshold 20%). See https://ci.internal/perf/4421

maria: getting a bisect started now. first suspect CL: 15987 (merge: fused-prefetch heuristic). tagging @jess @devon

ryan: quick thought — could be kv cache churn: fused prefetch may touch keys earlier causing eviction churn under concurrent batches. That would surface as more kv_cache_evict::sync samples

jess: good call. I measured KV occupancy during the run and saw repeated small evictions right before the decode step. attaching snippet in the issue (link in thread)

devon: bisect result: revert of CL 15987 makes the CI pass. CL 15987 is the regression.

maria: ok rollback candidate confirmed. but before we revert, can we try a hotfix: change kernel-chooser threshold to only select fused_v2 when seq_len <= 16 and batch_size <= 8? quick canary?

jess: deploying a canary with that tweak to perf-ci now

ci-bot: perf-ci: canary build/4422 PENDING

ryan: also put a metric on kv-eviction-rate in the canary; want to see if eviction rate drops with the tuned threshold

ci-bot: perf-ci: canary build/4422 PASSED — p95 within 5% of baseline. kv-eviction-rate down 75%

maria: great. roll forward with the threshold tweak as an emergency rollback patch and open a follow-up to fix the root cause in fused_v2_prefetch (kernel selection stateful misread). tagging eng-ml for kernel heuristics review

sre-ops: note for release notes: emergency patch to prefetch kernel heuristic landed — affected shortseq/low-batch workloads. no customer-facing outage but potential latency spike.

jess: adding test coverage: synthetic shortseq runs + kv occupancy asserts, and a CI gate to detect >= 1.5x p95 jumps for shortseq profile

maria: thanks team. follow-ups: (1) in-depth root cause for fused_v2 state machine (2) stronger perf CI golden runs for shortseq (3) consider making kernel-chooser config behind feature flag per deployment
devon: I'll own the root cause and the feature flag
